description: This file defines an abstract class 'Tensor' in Java that represents a multi-dimensional tensor object similar to PyTorch tensors. It includes methods for creating tensors from various data types and buffers, retrieving tensor data, and metadata such as shape and dtype. It also contains nested classes for specific tensor data types, like UINT8, INT8, INT32, FLOAT32, INT64, and FLOAT64, each managing raw data buffers accordingly.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: Abstract class representing a tensor object with various methods to create, query, and access tensor data. Supports multiple data types via nested subclasses.

classes.name: Tensor.Tensor_uint8
classes.description: Class for tensors with uint8 data type, managing a ByteBuffer of data.

classes.name: Tensor.Tensor_int8
classes.description: Class for tensors with int8 data type, managing a ByteBuffer of data.

classes.name: Tensor.Tensor_int32
classes.description: Class for tensors with int32 data type, managing an IntBuffer of data.

classes.name: Tensor.Tensor_float32
classes.description: Class for tensors with float32 data type, managing a FloatBuffer of data.

classes.name: Tensor.Tensor_int64
classes.description: Class for tensors with int64 data type, managing a LongBuffer of data.

classes.name: Tensor.Tensor_float64
classes.description: Class for tensors with float64 data type, managing a DoubleBuffer of data.

methods.name: allocateByteBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct ByteBuffer with native byte order for a given number of elements.

methods.name: allocateIntBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct IntBuffer with native byte order for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: allocateFloatBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct FloatBuffer with native byte order for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: allocateLongBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct LongBuffer with native byte order for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: allocateDoubleBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct DoubleBuffer with native byte order for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: fromBlobUnsigned
methods.description: Creates a uint8 tensor from an unsigned byte array or ByteBuffer and shape.

methods.name: fromBlob
methods.description: Creates tensors from various primitive arrays or buffers with a specified shape and memory format.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Calculates total number of elements given a shape array.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns a copy of the tensor's shape array.

methods.name: dtype
methods.description: Abstract method to return the data type of the tensor.

methods.name: memoryFormat
methods.description: Returns the memory format of the tensor.
